title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The life-saving multi-sectoral assistance to conflict and natural disaster-affected people in Somalia implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to improve the resilience of chronically-affected populations through enhanced access to high-quality nutrition, health, education; and improved emergency preparedness. The objectives of the grant is to ensure IDPs and vulnerable host households affected by natural disaster and conflict have access to basic needs including food and non-food items; to increase equitable access to quality education in a protective environment for children; to improve access to quality essential primary health and nutrition services; and to work with 5 local NGO partners to enhance preparedness and responses to natural disasters and conflicts. OBJECTIVES: Concern Somalia/Somaliland Programme and its 5 local NGO partners are better prepared to respond to natural disasters and conflictsOUTCOMES: To provide life-saving and life-sustaining multi-sectoral assistance to conflict and natural disaster affected most vulnerable people in Somalia/Somaliland.
